household_return_note.words: Household returns stay NO_SOURCE_YET: contract 0.4.3 sources every household-grain return ABSENT, and its read rule forbids a figure from a source it does not name; any change is the CTO's decision. Orion's client-keyed performance series would give a client-level index series, not an account-grain return, because it carries no account key.

method_words: Account first data dates: the earliest transDate of the account in the newest fact_transactions partition, which holds the full history (four of five accounts); for the one account with no transaction there, the earliest createdDate of its fact_positions rows (one of five). Account window statuses: NOT_SPANNED where the first data date is after the window's trading-day anchor, otherwise BREAK, because no account return row exists yet. Asset classes: not mapped to Opal's seven classes, because that placement reads a classification table outside this grant; hold.allocation is absent with NO_SOURCE_YET for every class. Account universe: the adapter's account_dim built from the newest fact_positions and fact_assets partitions (the basis of the dry run the checker recomputes from); all five accounts carry position rows on as-of. Market values: the as-of partition's position rows summed per account; the household figure is their sum.
